$comment: #EXP-1641 (owner 2026-11-06, drafts approved as drawn): ANSWER FROM THE NOTIFICATION ×2 (iOS `UNNotificationCategory` actions + `UNTextInputNotificationAction`, the category set per push by the Notification Service Extension; Android `NotificationCompat.Action`s + `RemoteInput`; web and desktop have none). Model = pure `notificationActions` + `askTextOptions` (src/notification-actions.ts; iOS ExpPush `NotificationActions.swift`, so the extension links it, Android `data/push/NotificationActions.kt`), every mirror replays the `*Cases`. WHICH PUSHES: a question/plan push (question-push.json) carries `dataKeys.messageId` + `dataKeys.cardKind`; a PLAINTEXT card also `dataKeys.options` (the question's option labels, a JSON array string), `dataKeys.custom` (`1` = free text allowed, `0` not) and `dataKeys.planQuestions` (a plan's question count). A SEALED card carries neither, but `dataKeys.sealed` = `1`: its options come from the ask text the phone opens with the tree key (`askTextOptions` over question-push.json's sealed text); no tree key held = `[open]`, the phone never answers what it cannot read or re-seal. Any other push naming a `sessionId` (a mention in a chat, a blocked or leftover session) gets `[reply]`, unless it is a sealed message's push (`dataKeys.sealed` = `1`, plus `rootId`) and the tree key is not held (`[]`): a reply to an encrypted chat is never sent in clear. Everything else: no actions. THE ACTIONS, in order. A plan: `approve` (button), `request-changes` (text), `open` (button); a plan WITH questions has no `approve` (its picks need the page). A question: one `option:<i>` button per option when there are at most `maxOptionButtons` minus one (free text) or `maxOptionButtons` (no free text) options, then `answer` (text) when free text is allowed; nothing at all = `[open]`. WHAT THEY DO, in the app's own process without opening it (iOS: no `.foreground`; Android: a BroadcastReceiver), every mutating one behind the device unlock (iOS `.authenticationRequired`, Android `setAuthenticationRequired(true)`): `approve` = sessions.answer `{messageId, decision: approved}`; `request-changes` = `{messageId, decision: rejected, feedback: <text>}`; `option:<i>` = `{messageId, answers: [<label>]}`; `answer` = `{messageId, answer: <text>}`; `reply` = sessions.send `{sessionId, text}` as the member's message, THE composer's send path. ALL go through the app's existing answer/send code, so a SEALED card or an ENCRYPTED chat is re-sealed / sealed ON THE PHONE with the tree key (SessionSealer) exactly like the session page: the text never leaves in clear. `open` opens the session like a tap (inbox-route.json). Success removes the notification; a failure (offline, already answered elsewhere: CONFLICT) replaces it with a local one titled `copy.failed` that opens the session. Copy below; no new component, the OS draws them.
